items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1963-03-29
items.q: that's my teacher, Lorenzo Teal, because that's where I really learned how to read and play.

ctx.x: Yeah, good old days. I started taking lessons on him, about eight or nine years old or something like that. Who was your teacher? Well, first I went to Professor Nickerson because Lorenzo Teal was in New York. And my brother was supposed to go to Mary Perez, and Mary Perez in New York, so he went to Charleneene. And I went to Professor Nickerson. So when Lorenzo Teal came back from New York, well, I went to Lorenzo Teal. In other words, that's my teacher, Lorenzo Teal, because that's where I really learned how to…
